The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for payments, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

Sovereign commerce infrastructure refers to a self-contained ecosystem that enables digital creators to host and sell their products without relying on third-party services. This approach ensures that creators maintain full control over their stores, products, and customer data. By using GitHub Pages for hosting, creators can establish a professional online presence without incurring significant costs or relying on restrictive payment processors.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign commerce infrastructure typically consists of several key components, including a hosting platform, a backend logic layer, and a payment processing system. GitHub Pages provides a robust and scalable hosting solution, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can be used to implement custom backend logic. Meanwhile, NOWPayments offers a seamless and low-cost payment processing solution that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides full control over your store and customer data.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of a sovereign commerce infrastructure include GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing. Additionally, creators can use Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. By integrating these components, creators can establish a seamless and efficient sales process that supports a wide range of digital products.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can start by setting up a GitHub Pages hosting platform and integrating a backend logic layer using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Next, they can configure NOWPayments for payment processing and set up order storage and file delivery solutions. With these components in place, creators can launch their online stores and start selling their digital products with confidence.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
GitHub Pages offers a robust and scalable hosting solution.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Complete Builder Kit, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, offers a convenient and cost-effective solution for digital creators looking to establish a sovereign commerce infrastructure. This kit provides all the necessary tools and documentation to deploy a robust and scalable online store.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: set up a GitHub Pages hosting platform, integrate a backend logic layer using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, configure NOWPayments for payment processing, set up order storage and file delivery solutions, and launch your online store. With these components in place, you can start selling your digital products with confidence and maintain full control over your store and customer data.
